date_scope_check.qualification: REC50-R17-002-P1: Closure from 5 February 2025 is recalled in September 2026 reporting. On 23 October 2026, Uzbek and Kazakh representatives were still coordinating simultaneous reopening: construction completion and readiness did not establish restored paired passage. The 625-day calendar separation to that later status report is a lower bound for the reported continuing restriction, not an exact elapsed-hour total or a reopening date. No operational reopening is established by the evidence cutoff of 26 October 2026.
